title: Italian Nutty Tiramisu Cake
description: Indulge in the rich flavors of Italy with this decadent nutty tiramisu cake, featuring espresso, mascarpone, and ground nuts. A perfect dessert for any occasion.
instructions: Line a 9x13-inch baking dish with parchment paper.
Dip ladyfingers in espresso for 3-5 seconds on each side. They should be soft and pliable but not too wet.
In a large mixing bowl, combine mascarpone cheese, granulated sugar, and vanilla extract. Beat with an electric mixer until smooth.
Add softened butter and mix until fully incorporated.
In a separate bowl, mix together ground almonds and cocoa powder.
To assemble the tiramisu, create a layer of ladyfingers in the prepared baking dish.
Spread half of the mascarpone mixture over the ladyfingers.
Sprinkle half of the almond-cocoa mixture over the mascarpone layer.
Repeat the layers, starting with the ladyfingers, then the mascarpone mixture, and finally the almond-cocoa mixture.
Dust the top of the tiramisu with confectioners' sugar.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 3 hours or overnight.
